title: Gabriel Faure, Emmanuel Pahud - Dolly Suite Opus 56 (1)

lines.l: 4A and the Bursers from his Dolly Suite.
Before that, Bocherini and his cello concerto number 8 in C.
Well, Pamela's been in touch and she says,
Hi, Marlene, I am listening to Classic FM
whilst walking in Cornwall Park, New Zealand
I always tune in to Classic FM.
Pamela, so lovely hearing where in the world you are listening from.
And I do imagine spring in New Zealand looks rather different
to what we are currently experiencing here.
It is a lovely part of the world
and it's so nice to be part of your day, Pamela.
